claim: A DukCity sewer does not lie under its street (under-street share 0.00 in all seven networks of the four maps): it is built elsewhere in map space and reached by 0-2 point entries per network (5 of the 6 entries an elevator, one a floor drop), its median depth 1.05-5.2 bodies (2.6-5.2 for all but DukCity1's pocket); five of its networks loop on their own (cycle rank 7-52), two small ones not at all. It is a destination with one or two doors, used as a required passage, a secret or a dead end, not as a shortcut.
evidence: tools/mine_sewers.py over DukCity1-4, 7 networks (knowledge/blood/references/sewer-mining.json; table in sewer-patterns.md:27-35)
use: When translating a Duke city, put its sewer truly under the street with Blood stacks, and keep entries rare.
